# Agent Zero

> Open-source autonomous engineer for validating, fixing, and verifying pull-request feedback.

## Start here

- README.md: product overview and quick start
- AGENTS.md: mandatory repository rules and package boundaries
- CONTRIBUTING.md: human and agent contribution workflow
- SECURITY.md: private reporting and security boundaries
- docs/architecture.md: dependency direction and execution model
- .agents/skills/: task-specific Agent Skills

## Commands

- pnpm check:repo
- pnpm lint:ci
- pnpm typecheck
- pnpm test
- pnpm build

## Non-negotiable constraints

- Keep the core runtime independent from HTTP, GitHub, terminal UI, and model providers.
- Execute target-repository commands and mutations only through the runner boundary.
- Keep observe mode read-only.
- Use deterministic tests without live network access.
- Use pnpm, Turborepo, tsdown, Oxlint, and Oxfmt.
